title: Leaf partitions skip the parent's policy
issue: RLS policies belong to the table named in the query. Querying a leaf partition directly (granted by a blanket GRANT on all tables) does not apply the parent's policy.
symptom: naive_rls: count(*) on app.documents_p_N returns every row of the leaf while the parent returns only the subject's rows (result mismatch vs baseline = the bug). best_practice_rls installs the policy on every leaf and return the same rows as the baseline.

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.documents_p (16 hash partitions on org_id); 100 docs per org, scale/20 users.
